story_pages: Yusuf has a red lunch box. His box has a chip on top.
Mum has a red lunch box. It has no chip on top.
Yusuf gets a red box. Is it his lunch box?
It has pasta and figs. But it has no chip.
Yusuf can check the top. His box has the chip.
Yusuf gets his lunch box. Mum gets the box with no chip.
questions: What mark is on Yusuf's lunch box?
Why is Yusuf not sure about the red box?
How does Yusuf find his box?

facts: In Istanbul, ferries carry people across the sparkling Bosphorus every day.
Harbour cats often nap on warm stones and enjoy gentle pats from friendly families.
Children in Turkey often greet each other with a cheerful “Merhaba!”
profile.culture: A Muslim family in Istanbul who love the ferry and feeding the cats by the harbour.
